_comment: Copy this file to config.json (or set ARTEX_CONFIG to use another path). This file contains only database and skill_dir; configure LLM and other settings with environment variables or in the application.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. ARTEX_PG_DSN takes precedence over database in this file. Choose one format: (A) fill in the fields below, or (B) set database.dsn to a complete connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Format (B): replace the database object above with a complete DSN. When dsn is non-empty, the individual fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: Root directory for skills (each subdirectory contains one skill and its SKILL.md). Precedence: ARTEX_SKILL_DIR, this field, then the default skills/ directory beside the executable. Leave empty or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.
